mapper.select: /* selectMasterMdCtBuyerReportList */ SELECT A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.STATUS , A.TR_YN , A.TR_TYPE , A.TRDT_YN , A.TRDT_TYPE , A.NEW_CONTRACT_YN , A.NEW_CONTRACT_TYPE , A.RD_YN , A.RD_TYPE , A.BUYER_CA_RD_YN , A.BUYER_CA_RD_TYPE , A.PD_YN , A.PD_TYPE , A.BUYER_CA_PD_YN , A.BUYER_CA_PD_TYPE , A.DE_CD_YN , A.DE_CD_TYPE , A.DE_WD_YN , A.DE_WD_TYPE , A.RE_CD_YN , A.RE_CD_TYPE , A.RE_WD_YN , A.RE_WD_TYPE , A.EVALUATION_YN , (SELECT COUNT(COD.CODE) FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'RPMP' AND COD.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD.TEXT1 = A.GROUP_CODE) AS GROUP_CODE_CNT , TO_CHAR(A.ADD_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS ADD_DATE , A.ADD_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NM , TO_CHAR(A.CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS CHANGE_DATE , A.CHANGE_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.CHANGE_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER_NM FROM KEP.KEP_REPORT A WHERE A.GROUP_CODE = #{st_group_cd} AND STATUS != 'D'

/* selectMasterMdCtBuyerReportMapList */ SELECT B.COM_CODE , B.COM_NAME_LOC , B.IRS_NO , B.CEO_NAME_LOC , A.TEXT1 AS GROUP_CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 A, ICOMCMPY B WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND A.TYPE ='RPMP' AND A.CODE = B.COM_CODE AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND A.TEXT1 = #{st_group_cd} AND A.FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY B.COM_CODE
/*selecMasterMdCtBuyerCheck2*/ SELECT A.CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND A.TYPE ='RPMP' AND A.CODE = #{COM_CODE} AND A.FLAG = 'Y'
mapper.update: /* insertMasterMdCtReportCustomerMng */ INSERT INTO ICOMCOD2 (TYPE , CODE , COMPANY_CODE , TEXT1 , FLAG , ADD_DATE) VALUES ('RPMP' , #{COM_CODE} , 'KRKORE0001' , #{GROUP_CODE} , 'Y' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'))
